boot.fileScope: The verified disk supplied the kernel, initramfs, device tree and partitions. A copy of the device tree enabled the emulated PL011 console on ttyAMA1. The regular-file disk copy was padded for the emulator's SD model.
boot.evidenceScope: Board-model Linux and OpenRC boot. Physical EEPROM and firmware boot, board Ethernet, configured portal startup and intended LAN performance remain unverified.
